sentences.text: Gareth Lloyd is the care assessor from the council.
Karen Wells is the daughter of Doreen Abbott.
Doreen Abbott is the person being assessed.
The care assessor is here to assess daily living needs.
Doreen Abbott can manage washing and dressing but cannot get into the bath and uses a strip wash at the sink.
Doreen Abbott goes up the stairs on her bottom some days and has expressed interest in a stairlift.
Karen Wells reported that Doreen nearly fell in October on the landing.
Doreen Abbott bruised her arm during the fall but did not go to hospital.
Doreen Abbott cooks occasionally, making soup and sandwiches, and says she is not one for cooking for one.
Karen brings meals to Doreen and she eats what is brought by Karen.
Doreen Abbott has her pension and a portion of Ron's council benefits.
Karen manages the bills on the computer.
Doreen Abbott said she feels lonely and that days are long and quiet, with no one to talk to.
Doreen Abbott said, 'I'd be better off dead, love' when asked about her feelings since Ron's death.
Doreen Abbott said it is just a saying at her age, common among older people, and not a serious statement.
Doreen Abbott said she has been saving 40 tablets since summer, not taking them and keeping them hidden.
Doreen Abbott said she would stop eating if she were put in a home, and that she wants to stay in her current home with Ron's belongings.
Karen Wells will drive Doreen to the lunch club at St Anne's on the first visit.
Doreen Abbott expressed interest in the lunch club at St Anne's, as Ron and she used to go there.
Karen Wells found the tablets hidden in Doreen's bedside drawer, in an envelope under hankies, with lots of different tablets.
Karen Wells took the tablets home with her after finding them.
The care assessor will refer Doreen for a stairlift assessment and a bath seat.
The care assessor will refer Doreen for a carer in the mornings for washing, starting small.
The care assessor will contact Dr Patel's surgery to arrange a GP appointment today or tomorrow.
Doreen Abbott said she would be okay with Dr Patel seeing her, as she does not want a fuss.
The care assessor will inform Dr Patel about what Doreen said during the assessment.
Karen Wells will take the tablets to the pharmacy today to be disposed of.
Karen Wells will sort weekly tablet packs with Kestle Pharmacy.
The care assessor will refer for a stairlift assessment by Friday.
The care assessor will return on Tuesday, the first of December.
